variants.headline: Request for more shipping refused
variants.body: The home world has refused the colony's request for more shipping. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.body: A colonial request for additional shipping has been rejected by the home world. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
